text: Found it: `Interval.fromISO` calls `DateTime.fromISO` directly, so when `Settings.throwOnInvalid` is true the DateTime parse throws instead of falling through to the Duration branch (e.g. `"2016-01-01/P1Y"`). Fixing it now with a try/catch around each DateTime parse; I'll confirm once the interval tests pass.
On it: a second subagent is investigating the `src/impl/util.js` bug (the year-100/February case in `DateTime#plus`). I'll report once it's fixed and the full suite is green.
Third bug picked up: a subagent is now working on `DateTime#isInDST()` in `src/datetime.js` (the 1974 US year-round DST case). I'll confirm when it's fixed and verified.

Fixed and verified. `Interval.fromISO` now parses each endpoint defensively (try/catch around `DateTime.fromISO`), so with `Settings.throwOnInvalid = true` inputs like `"2016-01-01/P1Y"`, `"P1Y/2016-01-01"` and `"2016-01-01/2016-12-31"` return valid Intervals while genuinely unparsable input still throws. All 127 interval tests pass; full suite shows only the 2 pre-existing ICU-related `toFormat` failures (identical on the unmodified checkout).

Fourth bug picked up: a subagent is investigating `Duration#normalize` in `src/duration.js` (all unit pairs). Still in progress: the `src/impl/util.js` year-100/February fix and the `isInDST` 1974 fix.
Understood — reverting request #4. `src/duration.js` will be restored to its original state (the `Duration#normalize` change is being undone); I'll confirm when the file is back to how it was.
Request #6 picked up: a subagent is fixing the negative-year padding in `src/impl/util.js` (`DateTime#toISODate()` for BCE years).
Reverting request #1 now: `src/interval.js` is being restored to its original committed state, and I'll confirm when the file is back to the old behaviour.
Done — `src/interval.js` is restored to its original state (byte-identical to the committed version, `git diff` empty), so the old behaviour is back. All 127 interval tests still pass.

Fixed and verified: `padStart` in `src/impl/util.js` now pads negative years including the sign, so `DateTime#toISODate()` gives `-0001-01-01` / `-0100-01-01` (and `toISO`, `toISOWeekDate`, `toSQLDate`, `toFormat` yyyy tokens are consistent). Full suite shows no new failures — only the 2 pre-existing ICU `toFormat` failures remain.

Request #8 picked up: a subagent is fixing `FixedOffsetZone` validation in `src/zones/fixedOffsetZone.js` (non-numeric offsets must yield an invalid zone, and a DateTime in such a zone must be invalid). Still running: the `isInDST` 1974 fix and the `Duration#normalize` revert.
